# NSGC Perspectives

> > NSGC Perspectives is the National Society of Genetic Counselors' premier publication providing clinical guidance, research insights, and professional development resources for genetic counseling practitioners.

Perspectives is the official journal of the National Society of Genetic Counselors (NSGC), featuring peer-reviewed articles, clinical practice resources, research findings, and leadership commentary on genetic counseling practice, education, and workforce development. The publication covers emerging topics including AI in genomics, patient accessibility, teratology, prenatal screening, and diversity in the genetic counseling profession.

## Key Topics

- Genetic Counseling
- Clinical Practice
- Patient Communication
- Teratology
- Prenatal Screening
- Genetic Testing
- Professional Development
- Career & Workforce
- Diversity & Inclusion
- NSGC
- CGC Certification
- Accessibility & ADA Compliance
- Genetic Care Access
- Research Articles
- Education & Training

## Core Content Hubs

- [Clinical Practice](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Clinical-Practice): Clinical practice resources on genetic counseling, teratology, and patient communication
- [Research](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Research): Research articles on genetic testing, prenatal screening, and clinical guidelines
- [Education](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Education): Educational resources on genetic counseling, diversity, and professional development
- [Career & Workforce](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Career-Workforce): Career development and workforce trends in genetic counseling profession

## Featured Articles

- [Teratology Insights: Strengthening the Genetic Counselor's Toolkit](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Article/teratology-insights-strengthening-the-genetic-counselors-toolkit): Article on teratology and medication safety in genetic counseling practice
- [Redefining "Effective Communication:" Supporting Patients With Hearing and Vision Loss in Genetic Counseling](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Article/redefining-effective-communication-supporting-patients-with-hearing-and-vision-loss-in-genetic-counseling): Article on accessibility and ADA compliance in genetic counseling communication
- [Cost of Entry: The New Financial Reality of Genetic Counseling Training](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Article/cost-of-entry-the-new-financial-reality-of-genetic-counseling-training): Article on education costs and student debt in genetic counseling training
- [March President's Message: When the World is Heavy](https://perspectives.nsgc.org/Article/march-presidents-message-when-the-world-is-heavy): NSGC president's message on resilience and patient care in genetic counseling
